description: This file defines the PubSubSubscriptionState class used in Orleans streaming for managing subscription state, including serialization attributes, equality checks, and state management methods.

classes.name: PubSubSubscriptionState
classes.description: Represents the state of a pub/sub subscription, including its ID, stream, consumer, filter data, and current state.

methods.name: PubSubSubscriptionState
methods.description: Constructor initializing the subscription state with provided IDs and setting the initial state to Active.

methods.name: AddFilter
methods.description: Adds filter data to the subscription.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object or subscription state.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on SubscriptionId.

methods.name: Fault
methods.description: Sets the subscription state to Faulted.
